body.bible_version: Scripture quotations taken from The Holy Bible, New International Version® NIV®

verses.1: Blessed is the man who does not walk in the counsel of the wicked or stand in the way of sinners or sit in the seat of mockers.
verses.2: But his delight is in the law of the LORD, and on his law he meditates day and night.
verses.3: He is like a tree planted by streams of water, which yields its fruit in season and whose leaf does not wither. Whatever he does prospers.
verses.4: Not so the wicked! They are like chaff that the wind blows away.
verses.5: Therefore the wicked will not stand in the judgment, nor sinners in the assembly of the righteous.
verses.6: For the LORD watches over the way of the righteous, but the way of the wicked will perish.

verses.1: Why do the nations conspire and the peoples plot in vain?
verses.2: The kings of the earth take their stand and the rulers gather together against the LORD and against his Anointed One.
verses.3: "Let us break their chains," they say, "and throw off their fetters."
verses.4: The One enthroned in heaven laughs; the Lord scoffs at them.
verses.5: Then he rebukes them in his anger and terrifies them in his wrath, saying,
verses.6: "I have installed my King on Zion, my holy hill."
verses.7: I will proclaim the decree of the LORD: He said to me, "You are my Son; today I have become your Father.
verses.8: Ask of me, and I will make the nations your inheritance, the ends of the earth your possession.
verses.9: You will rule them with an iron scepter; you will dash them to pieces like pottery."
verses.10: Therefore, you kings, be wise; be warned, you rulers of the earth.
verses.11: Serve the LORD with fear and rejoice with trembling.
verses.12: Kiss the Son, lest he be angry and you be destroyed in your way, for his wrath can flare up in a moment. Blessed are all who take refuge in him.

verses.1: O LORD, how many are my foes! How many rise up against me!
verses.2: Many are saying of me, "God will not deliver him." Selah
verses.3: But you are a shield around me, O LORD; you bestow glory on me and lift up my head.
verses.4: To the LORD I cry aloud, and he answers me from his holy hill. Selah
verses.5: I lie down and sleep; I wake again, because the LORD sustains me.
verses.6: I will not fear the tens of thousands drawn up against me on every side.
verses.7: Arise, O LORD! Deliver me, O my God! Strike all my enemies on the jaw; break the teeth of the wicked.
verses.8: From the LORD comes deliverance. May your blessing be on your people. Selah

verses.1: Answer me when I call to you, O my righteous God. Give me relief from my distress; be merciful to me and hear my prayer.
verses.2: How long, O men, will you turn my glory into shame? How long will you love delusions and seek false gods? Selah
verses.3: Know that the LORD has set apart the godly for himself; the LORD will hear when I call to him.
verses.4: In your anger do not sin; when you are on your beds, search your hearts and be silent. Selah
verses.5: Offer right sacrifices and trust in the LORD.
verses.6: Many are asking, "Who can show us any good?" Let the light of your face shine upon us, O LORD.
verses.7: You have filled my heart with greater joy than when their grain and new wine abound.
verses.8: I will lie down and sleep in peace, for you alone, O LORD, make me dwell in safety.

verses.1: Give ear to my words, O LORD, consider my sighing.
verses.2: Listen to my cry for help, my King and my God, for to you I pray.
verses.3: In the morning, O LORD, you hear my voice; in the morning I lay my requests before you and wait in expectation.
verses.4: You are not a God who takes pleasure in evil; with you the wicked cannot dwell.
verses.5: The arrogant cannot stand in your presence; you hate all who do wrong.
verses.6: You destroy those who tell lies; bloodthirsty and deceitful men the LORD abhors.
verses.7: But I, by your great mercy, will come into your house; in reverence will I bow down toward your holy temple.
verses.8: Lead me, O LORD, in your righteousness because of my enemies- make straight your way before me.
verses.9: Not a word from their mouth can be trusted; their heart is filled with destruction. Their throat is an open grave; with their tongue they speak deceit.
verses.10: Declare them guilty, O God! Let their intrigues be their downfall. Banish them for their many sins, for they have rebelled against you.
verses.11: But let all who take refuge in you be glad; let them ever sing for joy. Spread your protection over them, that those who love your name may rejoice in you.
verses.12: For surely, O LORD, you bless the righteous; you surround them with your favor as with a shield.

verses.1: O LORD, do not rebuke me in your anger or discipline me in your wrath.
verses.2: Be merciful to me, LORD, for I am faint; O LORD, heal me, for my bones are in agony.
verses.3: My soul is in anguish. How long, O LORD, how long?
verses.4: Turn, O LORD, and deliver me; save me because of your unfailing love.
verses.5: No one remembers you when he is dead. Who praises you from the grave?
verses.6: I am worn out from groaning; all night long I flood my bed with weeping and drench my couch with tears.
verses.7: My eyes grow weak with sorrow; they fail because of all my foes.
verses.8: Away from me, all you who do evil, for the LORD has heard my weeping.
verses.9: The LORD has heard my cry for mercy; the LORD accepts my prayer.
verses.10: All my enemies will be ashamed and dismayed; they will turn back in sudden disgrace.
